rules: speaker contributions are summed as complex pressure, not dB magnitudes
gain, delay, polarity, crossover filters, speaker response and directional coupling are applied before summation
disabled SpeakerSets suppress their member contributions without destroying member state
SpeakerSet members are resolved to world transforms and then evaluated as individual Speaker contributions
frequency-range visualization must be derived from the same underlying phase-aware field
speaker position or orientation changes invalidate affected coupling and field samples immediately
SpeakerSet parent or member transform changes invalidate affected coupling and field samples immediately
interactive visualization recomputes at most once per animation frame and does not wait for drag end
frequencyRange is a requested analysis range and must not imply an unrelated hard-coded global solver maximum
